# [TASK] Implement Config Service (Spring Cloud Config)

## Task
Spring Cloud Config Server for centralized configuration — serves per-service, per-environment YAML to the other backend services over HTTP.

## Parent Story
Parent: #84

## Scope
Git-backed config and at-rest encryption were both in the original spec but descoped — see Notes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Config server starts on port 8888, `/actuator/health` returns UP
- [x] Serves per-service, per-profile config over HTTP (e.g. `/movie-service/default`, `/movie-service/dev`, `/application/prod`) from the classpath `native` backend
- [x] Secrets never live in the config files — injected as `${ENV_VAR}` placeholders, the shape Kubernetes Secrets consume
- [x] Registers with Eureka
- [x] Tests passing (`ConfigServerIntegrationTest`, `ConfigServiceApplicationTests`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
- Implemented 2025-11-15 (`6539256`, `551c53a`, `47e21f8`, `acf825e`). This issue's `closedAt` reads 2026-07-28 only because it was left open and closed later in an unrelated hygiene sweep — the code has been live since Sprint 1.
- Git-backed config and encryption were descoped per [ADR-005](../../docs/architecture/adr/005-eureka-config-vs-kubernetes-native.md): Config Service runs in `native` mode and isn't deployed to Kubernetes, so a Git backend would serve a component that doesn't exist in the target environment; encrypting values that get replaced by env-var placeholders would just encrypt data about to be discarded.
